settings.heading: Ceremonial Stone Ground Matcha
settings.subheading: Hand-harvested Uji green tea leaves shade-grown for 20 days and ground by granite stone mills.

settings.heading: Shade grown for 20 days.
settings.body: Our tea bushes are covered with black screens to block out 90% of sunlight before harvesting. This forces the plant to push amino acids and sweet L-theanine into the leaves, yielding sweet, vivid green ceremonial matcha.

settings.quote: The Uji matcha is incredibly smooth. Very minimal bitterness with an intense umami sweet finish.
settings.name: Hana Y.

settings.quote: Vibrant jade green color. You can instantly tell it is stone ground and fresh.
settings.name: Liam D.

settings.quote: Excellent clean energy. I replaced my morning espresso with this loose leaf Oolong.
settings.name: Elena B.
